import itertools, json, random, sys, time, io, resource
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
import driver
from ebpf.create_dfa import create, registry_columns
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
cols,colmap=registry_columns(reg)
def timed(label,text,c=cols,m=colmap):
    t=time.time()
    try:
        img=create(text,c,m)
        print('%-40s rows=%-6d cells=%-7d %.2fs'%(label,len(img.rows),img.cells,time.time()-t))
        return img
    except Exception as e:
        print('%-40s %-22s %.2fs'%(label,type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)[:12],time.time()-t))
# biggest legal family: all sequences of length L over 2 symbols
for L in (10,12,13):
    words=[''.join(p) for p in itertools.product('AB',repeat=L)]
    # map A,B to registered names
    txt=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join('S0'+ch for ch in w) for w in words)
    timed('all len%d over 2 syms (%d psvc)'%(L,L*len(words)), txt)
# near cap: 3000 words length 8 + endswith drop
rng=random.Random(1)
w=set()
while len(w)<3000: w.add(tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(8)))
txt=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(x) for x in w)+' endswith(S00,S01,S02,S03) drop;'
timed('3000 words len8 + endswith drop', txt)
PYEOF
